name: claude-skills-library
description: A library of skills for Claude

scripts.lint: markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md" && npm run lint:emdash && npm run lint:emoji
scripts.lint:emdash: ! grep -rn '—' --include='*.md' . --exclude-dir=node_modules || (echo 'Error: Em dashes found. Use -- or - instead.' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:emoji:
result=$(find . -name '*.md' ! -path './node_modules/*' -exec grep -l '[😀-🙏🌀-🗿🚀-🛿✀-➿🤀-🧿❌✅🎯📋👥📊💡🧪📚🎨⚡⚙️🚫🔄🤝📝🔗]' {} \; 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$result" ] || (echo "Error: Emojis found in:
$result" && exit 1)
